zh: 你说到了一个特别好的点，因为我们所有人，不管我们有多成功或者做什么工作，可能都有一些冒充者综合征、不安全感，或者让我们不舒服的事，或者觉得自己不够好的地方。

speaker: Unknown
en: And when another human gives you a little pep talk or word of encouragement or says, no, no, no, yeah, yeah, you should do that and gives you a glimpse of hope, that is game changing and can get you over the hump and can all of a sudden sent you on a trajectory that you had no idea that you were going to go on.
zh: 而当另一个人给你一点鼓励的话、一句打气的话，或者说，不不不，对对对，你应该去做，给你一丝希望，那是能改变一切的，能帮你跨过那道坎，能突然把你送上一条你根本没想到自己会走的轨迹。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I agree.
zh: 所以我同意。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's such a great reminder for all of us to just, you know, to be able to do that because.
zh: 这对我们所有人都是一个特别好的提醒，就是，你知道，能够去那样做，因为。

speaker: Unknown
en: It doesn't take a lot.
zh: 这不需要付出很多。

en: And being authentic with it.

zh: 你的朋友大概是那种，对啊，当然。

speaker: Unknown
en: He's genuine and had conviction.
zh: 他是真心的，而且有信念。

speaker: Unknown

zh: 然后你就想，哦，我相信这个。

zh: 我加入了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I can do it.
zh: 我能做到。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I feel like, too, everything in life, there's some social element to it.
zh: 而且我觉得，生活中的一切，都有某种社交层面的因素。

speaker: Unknown
en: And going against the grain, whether it's internally what you think or what society says you should do,
zh: 逆流而行，无论是违背你内心的想法，还是违背社会说你应该做的事，

speaker: Unknown
en: If there's just like that extra bump, like you really just need like a little bit, because like being the only person that goes against something or try something new, like if you just have like a little bit of encouragement, so it's like you're investing in this company with the founder, like, dude, you're doing this, you're trying to like put data centers in space.
zh: 如果有那额外的一点推动，就像你真的只需要一点点，因为作为唯一一个反对某件事或尝试新事物的人，如果你只有一点点鼓励，就像你在和创始人一起投资这家公司，比如，兄弟，你在做这个，你正试着把数据中心放进太空。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like, sounds crazy, but I think it's a good idea.
zh: 听起来很疯狂，但我觉得这是个好主意。

en: Because
zh: 因为

en: To your point, when you're embarking on something where everybody else is like, that's kind of, I don't know about that one.
zh: 正如你说的，当你着手做一件所有人都觉得“那……我对那个不太确定”的事情时，

speaker: Unknown
en: You're an outlier in moving in that space.
zh: 你在朝着那个方向前进的路上是个异类。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's reassuring that you're not crazy when somebody says, no, you're on the right path.
zh: 当有人说，不，你走的是正确的道路时，你会很安心，因为你没有疯。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'll give this guy credit.
zh: 我要给这家伙点赞。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's a gentleman named Samir Khaji, who runs a firm, a company now called Allocate.
zh: 有位先生叫 Samir Khaji，他现在经营着一家公司，叫 Allocate。

speaker: Unknown
en: When we first got started at Nextplay, he was one of the first people like, I'm trying to do this.
zh: 当我们刚开始做 Nextplay 的时候，他是最早说“我想做这件事”的人之一。

speaker: Unknown
en: And he became our banker.
zh: 后来他成了我们的银行家。

speaker: Unknown
en: And he said, this is how you're going to do it.
zh: 他说，你们要这样做。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I said, you're right.
zh: 我说，你说得对。

en: And I believed him.
zh: 我相信了他。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it sent us on this trajectory.
zh: 这让我们走上了这条轨迹。

en: And having people around you, again, that
zh: 而且再说一次，身边要有这样的人，

speaker: Unknown
en: Our part of your starting five, I think about that a lot, that have a level of expertise that can speak into you and help you navigate the world is really important.
zh: 属于你的首发五人组，我很常想到这一点，他们拥有一定水平的专业能力，能对你说出真知灼见，帮助你在这个世界中航行，这真的非常重要。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so, yeah, I love that reminder, Turner.
zh: 所以，是的，我喜欢这个提醒，Turner。

speaker: Unknown
en: I appreciate that.
zh: 谢谢你。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I have to ask you about this, because my brothers are going to kill me that we don't talk about it.
zh: 我必须问问你这件事，因为如果我们不聊它，我兄弟们会杀了我的。

speaker: Unknown
en: We talked about it a little bit earlier, but you were on the Lions, the 0-16 team.
zh: 我们之前稍微聊过一点，你曾效力于雄狮队，那支 0 胜 16 负的球队。

speaker: Unknown
en: We grew up in Michigan.
zh: 我们在密歇根长大。

speaker: Unknown
en: We grew up Lions fans.
zh: 我们从小就是雄狮队的球迷。

speaker: Unknown
en: Oh, man, we're going back again.
zh: 哦，天哪，我们又回到那个话题了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Oh, no.
zh: 哦，不。

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, so, I mean, what was that season like?
zh: 那么，那个赛季是什么样的？

speaker: Unknown
en: Like, just like going through that, like, I'm assuming it had to be hard on the team.
zh: 就像，经历那种事，我猜对球队来说肯定很难熬。

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, yes, it was extremely difficult.
zh: 嗯，是的，那极其艰难。

speaker: Unknown
en: They fired our GM during the season.
zh: 他们在赛季中途解雇了我们的总经理。

speaker: Unknown
en: We had players that were on contract that they just sent home like, hey, don't show up anymore.
zh: 我们有一些还在合同期内的球员，他们直接让人家回家，就像，嘿，不用再来了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Just go home.
zh: 直接回家吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: We'll keep paying you because you're not even worth being in the locker room anymore.
zh: 我们会继续付你钱，因为你已经连待在更衣室里的价值都没有了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Geez, I didn't even know you could do that.
zh: 天哪，我都不知道还能那样做。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, neither did I. I think we had four or five quarterbacks that year play and start.
zh: 是啊，我也不知道。我记得那年我们有三四个还是四五个四分卫出场并首发过。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, I remember that.
zh: 是啊，我记得。

speaker: Unknown
en: That was the year that I think the guy ran out the back of the end zone on the same TV.
zh: 就是那个人在同一个电视画面里冲出端区后沿的那一年。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, Dan Orlowski.
zh: 是啊，Dan Orlowski。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, who's a great guy and a great commentator and is doing an excellent job on TV now.
zh: 是啊，他是个很好的人，也是位很棒的解说员，现在在电视上做得很出色。

speaker: Unknown
en: But we had to go get Dante Culpepper off the couch and come out of retirement to try to come and play quarterback for us.
zh: 但当时我们不得不让 Dante Culpepper 从沙发上起来，结束退休来试着给我们打四分卫。

speaker: Unknown
en: We were doing anything we could.
zh: 我们能试的都试了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the challenging part in Detroit was it was an environment that
zh: 而在底特律最难的部分是，那是一个这样的环境：

speaker: Unknown
en: The negative sentiments and...
zh: 那些负面的情绪和……

speaker: Unknown
en: I'll never forget that.
zh: 我永远不会忘记那个。

speaker: Unknown
en: I remember at some point saying, gosh dang, like there's no way that today can be worse than yesterday.
zh: 我记得在某个时刻我说，老天，今天不可能比昨天更糟了吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think that started that mindset, like that question in my mind kind of would start coming up in like week three.
zh: 我觉得就是从那时起，那种心态开始形成，那个问题大概在第三周左右开始在我脑子里冒出来。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it happened every day since.
zh: 而且从那以后每天都在发生。

speaker: Unknown
en: Each day kind of got a little bit worse.
zh: 每一天都变得更糟一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it just became unfortunate that we ended up not being very good and losing every game.
zh: 最后我们打得不好、输掉每场比赛，真的很不幸。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I learned a lot.
zh: 我学到了很多。

speaker: Unknown
en: And actually, that's where I learned the lesson about Nextplay.
zh: 其实，我就是在那里学到了 Nextplay 这个道理。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I give my father credit because I remember reaching out to him.
zh: 这要归功于我父亲，因为我记得我联系了他。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was like week five or seven and just talking to him because I felt like there was plays that were happening.
zh: 大概是第五周或第七周，我跟他聊，因为我觉得当时有些场上发生的情况——

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you so much for joining us.
zh: 非常感谢你们加入我们。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you for joining us.
zh: 感谢你们加入我们。

speaker: Unknown
en: And how you got over it.
zh: 以及你是怎么走出来的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And he goes, what are you talking about?
zh: 他说，你在说什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: And I go, you know, you're like, when you messed up.
zh: 我说，你知道，就是你搞砸了的时候。

speaker: Unknown
en: He goes, I never messed up.
zh: 他说，我从来没搞砸过。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I was like, oh my gosh, yeah, I know.
zh: 我当时就想，天哪，好吧，我知道了。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is why I don't ask you for advice.
zh: 这就是为什么我不向你要建议。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm like, good play or bad play?
zh: 我说，好球还是坏球？

speaker: Unknown
en: Like, just tell me, what did you do to move on?
zh: 就告诉我，你是怎么走出来的？

speaker: Unknown
en: He's like, that's the whole point, Ryan.
zh: 他说，Ryan，这就是全部的关键所在。

speaker: Unknown
en: The play didn't exist anymore.
zh: 那个球已经不存在了。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was over.
zh: 它已经结束了。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was gone.
zh: 它消失了。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's forgotten about.
zh: 它被忘掉了。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it didn't happen in his mind.
zh: 所以在他的脑子里那球根本没发生过。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like, he literally still, like, I'm in the next play.
zh: 就是他真的还是，我在打下一个球。

speaker: Unknown
en: So, like, having that mindset to be able to move on.
zh: 所以，拥有那种能够向前走的心态。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's something not only, that's why we ended up naming our firm initially Nextplay is because whether in sports or in business or in our personal lives, our ability to process the situation, good or bad, and move on is really important.
zh: 而这不仅——这就是为什么我们最初把公司命名为 Nextplay，因为无论是在体育、商业还是个人生活中，我们处理当时的处境——无论好坏——然后向前走的能力真的很重要。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I've gotten myself out of a lot of bad situations with my wife and mistakes I've made because I've learned to try to process and forgive and say I'm sorry and say it was me and I messed up.
zh: 我靠这个走出了很多和妻子之间的糟糕处境，也走出了我犯的错误，因为我学会了去处理、原谅、说对不起、承认是我、是我搞砸了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Hopefully she listens so I can get some brownie points for this because I had the next play mindset, right?
zh: 希望她能听到这段，这样我能加点分，因为我有了下一个球的心态，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: And just move on and get over that.
zh: 然后就向前走，把那件事翻篇。 [[803→830]] 当你在后视镜里停留太久，你就会忘记你正开着车往前看的前挡风玻璃，它让你看到你要去哪里。

speaker: Unknown
en: When you dwell too much in the rearview mirror, you forget about the front windshield that you're driving in the car and giving you a glimpse of where you're going.
zh: 当你过分盯着后视镜时,你会忘记你正开着车,前挡风玻璃才能让你看到前方的去向。

speaker: Unknown
en: You got to look out ahead, not behind.
zh: 你得往前看，而不是往回看。

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, I feel like any hard thing in life, whether it's playing a sport, starting a company, running a company, everyone sees the external headlines, but nobody sees under the hood of like,
zh: 我觉得生活中的任何难事，无论是打体育、创业、经营公司，每个人都只看到外部的头条新闻，但没有人看到引擎盖下面，比如——

speaker: Unknown
en: You had 100 people say no before one person said yes.
zh: 在有一个人说 yes 之前，你被 100 个人拒绝过。

speaker: Unknown
en: Or you lost 100 games, you got injured six times before you made it to the NFL or you won the Super Bowl.
zh: 或者你输了 100 场比赛，受过 6 次伤，才进入 NFL 或者赢得超级碗。

speaker: Unknown
en: You go 0-16 or you had losing seasons, you didn't get re-signed, you got traded because you weren't good.
zh: 你打出 0 胜 16 负，或者经历过输球的赛季，没有被续约，因为打得不好而被交易。

speaker: Unknown
en: All those things.
zh: 所有这些事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: Nobody's just successful at every single thing that they do.
zh: 没有人在自己做的每一件事上都成功。

speaker: Unknown
en: No, it's just this continuum.
zh: 不，这只是个连续的过程。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's where I think Brady has talked about what's not losing, it's learning.
zh: 这就是为什么我觉得 Brady 说过，不是输球，而是学习。

speaker: Unknown
en: You're just constantly in this state of learning and growing and iterating.
zh: 你只是持续处于这种学习、成长和迭代的状态。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the hardest part is to maintain confidence and to maintain conviction, even when it's a sustained period of downtimes.
zh: 最难的部分是保持信心、保持信念，即使在一段持续的低迷期里。

speaker: Unknown
en: How do you keep having that conviction to keep going and moving forward?
zh: 你怎么持续保持那种信念，继续前进？

speaker: Unknown
en: There's a book by Napoleon Hill called Three Feet from Gold that reminds me of a lot of people get, they're so close to their goal and then they give up just before that opportunity.
zh: Napoleon Hill 写过一本书叫 Three Feet from Gold，它让我想起很多人离目标非常近，然后就在那个机会到来之前放弃了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And usually that's probably at the hardest moment in the most difficult time and you tap out.
zh: 而且那通常可能是在最艰难的时刻、最困难的时候，你放弃了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I will say that's, you know, some of the similarities between elite athletes and elite founders is this mental toughness.
zh: 我想说，这就是精英运动员和精英创始人之间的相似之处，就是这种心理韧性。

speaker: Unknown
en: In this unbelievable ability to have an incredible high pain tolerance and an incredible ability to feel very comfortable in the most uncomfortable environments.
zh: 这种难以置信的高疼痛耐受能力，以及在最不舒服的环境里感觉非常舒服的难以置信的能力。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that mental toughness and mindset allows them to keep moving forward and suspending disbelief
zh: 而这种心理韧性和心态让他们能持续向前，搁置怀疑——

speaker: Unknown
en: And the reality of the situation because they keep hoping, they keep believing.
zh: 以及当下的现实处境，因为他们持续抱着希望，持续相信。

speaker: Unknown
en: Is there in that book or maybe what you've personally, how you personally approach like is there like a trick or like a tactic for doing that?
zh: 在那本书里，或者从你个人的角度、你个人是怎么应对的，有没有什么诀窍或者技巧可以做到这一点？

speaker: Unknown
en: It's just like the never stop believing and also how do you know like maybe this case specifically like it's not worth happening?
zh: 这就像永远不要停止相信，而且你怎么知道，比如也许在这个特定的情况下，它不值得继续下去？

speaker: Unknown
en: You need to stop believing this and maybe try the new thing.
zh: 你需要停止相信这个，也许可以尝试新的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think in life, we go through tests to help strengthen our testimony.
zh: 我认为在生活中，我们经历考验来帮助坚定我们的信念。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the more tests we go through, the stronger our testimony is.
zh: 我们经历的考验越多，我们的信念就越坚定。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it's that testimony that we look back on.
zh: 而正是那份信念，我们会回头去看。

speaker: Unknown
en: That gives us the strength to push through the obstacles and challenges and adversities that we're facing in the present day.
zh: 它给了我们力量去克服当下正在面对的障碍、挑战和逆境。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I think that's one trick is to remind yourself of what you have done, what you did go through, how you overcame.
zh: 所以我认为这是一个诀窍，就是提醒自己你做成过什么，你经历过什么，你是如何克服的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think sometimes we forget those things of maybe the five collar broken bones and like, how do I keep moving forward?
zh: 而且我觉得有时候我们会忘记那些事情，也许是五根锁骨骨折之类的，然后想，我该怎么继续前进？

speaker: Unknown
en: And so you got to look back at that.
zh: 所以你必须回头看那些。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then the second, for me, I'm constantly trying to work on my mental toughness.
zh: 然后，第二点，对我来说，我在不断地锻炼我的心理韧性。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so people are like, how do you do that?
zh: 所以人们会问，你是怎么做到的？

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think for me, every month I pick a very small task.
zh: 而我认为对我来说，每个月我会挑一个非常小的任务。

speaker: Unknown
en: It might be writing a letter.
zh: 可能是写一封信。

speaker: Unknown
en: It might be opening doors with the left hand.
zh: 可能是用左手开门。

speaker: Unknown
en: It might be brushing my teeth on one foot.
zh: 可能是单脚站着刷牙。

speaker: Unknown
en: But every day I have to do something.
zh: 但每天我必须做一些事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: Are those all ones that you've done?
zh: 这些都是你做过的吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, for an entire month, for an entire month.
zh: 是的，整整一个月，整整一个月。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it's really hard to do, like, it's not hard.
zh: 而且真的很难做到，比如，它不难。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's like, I can do brush my teeth and stand on one foot.
zh: 就像，我可以单脚站着刷牙。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's the hard part is to remind yourself to do that every single day and to, you know, when there's times where you're, maybe you're late from, you just want to get in the bed or whatever it may be, there's a distraction, that's when you got to still stay committed.
zh: 难的部分是提醒自己每天都要做这件事，而且，你知道，有时候你，也许你迟了，你就是想上床睡觉或者别的情况，有个干扰出现，那时候你还是得坚持住。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so...
zh: 所以……

speaker: Unknown
en: That's ways that I kind of try to at least play with my mind and know that there are going to be moments in my business and in my career and in life where things are going to get really hard and uncomfortable.
zh: 这就是我在某种程度上尝试和自己的大脑玩耍的方式，让我知道在我的事业、我的职业生涯和生活中，会有一些时刻事情会变得非常艰难和不舒服。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it'd be easy for me to be like, I'm out.
zh: 那时候我很容易说，我不干了。

speaker: Unknown
en: But that's hopefully I can remind myself that if we stick with it, we can get to the other side.
zh: 但希望我能提醒自己，如果我们坚持下去，我们可以到达另一边。

speaker: Unknown
en: I wanted to ask you about this.
zh: 我想问你一件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: When you sold your company to Fox,
zh: 当你把公司卖给 Fox 之后，
